diff --git a/hardware/bbq/generator/bbq_level_lx.py b/hardware/bbq/generator/bbq_level_lx.py
index a038e03..9ffbbce 100644
--- a/hardware/bbq/generator/bbq_level_lx.py
+++ b/hardware/bbq/generator/bbq_level_lx.py
@@ -12,7 +12,37 @@ if typing.TYPE_CHECKING: from bbq import BBQ
 
 
 class BBQLevelLX(BBQLevel):
-    """Represents an LX BBQ level."""
+    """Represents an LX BBQ level.
+
+    Every level keeps its bitmaps, count-is-one flags and subtree occupancy
+    counters in registers, and updates all of its rows in parallel in a single
+    decide stage. The state an operation observes in its decide stage thus
+    already reflects every older operation, so back-to-back operations need
+    no forwarding and the per-cycle recurrence stays shallow.
+
+    The decide stage also registers a per-entry "hit" flag (the entry that the
+    operation increments or decrements). Later stages reduce these flags
+    across rows to recover the one-hot digit of the operation, off the
+    recurrence.
+
+    Stages (D = number of bitmap levels):
+      L1 (not leaf):  S          decide; one-hot digit computed in-stage.
+      Lk (not leaf):  S, S+1     decide; reduce hit flags to the digit.
+      Leaf:           S .. S+3   decide; partial reductions; encode the
+                                 priority and bucket flags; PB read with
+                                 address-conflict detection.
+
+    State is held in packed vectors indexed by entry (row * W + bit), and all
+    per-entry logic is written as flat loops, which keeps the simulation model
+    compact for wide or deep configurations.
+
+    For two or three levels, a leaf with more than 1024 entries instead keeps
+    its rows in register files (row read, forwarding of the previous
+    operation's post-operation row, write back) with the same stage count,
+    which bounds synthesis effort at a somewhat longer critical path. Trees
+    beyond the register-state budget (LX_HUGE) are not served: their heavy
+    levels reduce to a stub so that evaluation time stays bounded.
+    """
     def __init__(self, bbq: BBQ, start_cycle: int, level_id: int,
                  sram_bitmap: bool, sram_counters: bool) -> None:
 
@@ -42,29 +72,725 @@ class BBQLevelLX(BBQLevel):
 
     def latency(self) -> int:
         """Latency in cycles."""
-        return 1 + int(self.sram_bitmap) + int(self.sram_counters)
+        if self.level_id == self.num_bitmap_levels:
+            return 3
+        return 0 if self.level_id == 1 else 1
+
+
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    # Stage bookkeeping
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    @property
+    def k(self) -> int:
+        return self.level_id
+
+    @property
+    def last(self) -> bool:
+        """Leaf level (computed from the depth, valid before linking)."""
+        return self.level_id == self.num_bitmap_levels
+
+    @property
+    def d_stage(self) -> int:
+        """Decide stage: updates the level state."""
+        return self.start_cycle
+
+    @property
+    def digit_stage(self) -> int:
+        """Stage at whose end the full one-hot digit is registered."""
+        return self.start_cycle + (0 if self.k == 1 else 1)
+
+    @property
+    def r_stage(self) -> int:
+        """Leaf only: partial-reduction stage."""
+        return self.start_cycle + 1
+
+    @property
+    def e_stage(self) -> int:
+        """Leaf only: encode stage."""
+        return self.start_cycle + 2
+
+    @property
+    def p_stage(self) -> int:
+        """Leaf only: PB read stage."""
+        return self.start_cycle + 3
+
+    def leaf_level(self) -> BBQLevelLX:
+        return self.bbq.bitmap_levels[-1]
+
+    def digit_last_stage(self) -> int:
+        """Last stage whose registered one-hot digit is consumed."""
+        return self.leaf_level().r_stage
+
+    def digit_reg(self, k: int, stage: int) -> str:
+        return "reg_lx_d{}_s{}".format(k, stage)
+
+    def prio_digit(self, k: int, stage_reg: str) -> str:
+        """Binary digit of level k within a registered priority."""
+        shift = self.num_bitmap_levels - k
+        return "{}[{} * HEAP_LOG_BITMAP_WIDTH +: HEAP_LOG_BITMAP_WIDTH]".format(
+            stage_reg, shift)
+
+    def row_select(self, s: int, row: str) -> typing.List[str]:
+        """One-hot digit terms selecting `row` of this level at stage s."""
+        k = self.k
+        return ["{}[(({}) >> ({} * HEAP_LOG_BITMAP_WIDTH)) & BITMAP_IDX_MASK]".format(
+                    self.digit_reg(j, s), row, k - 1 - j) for j in range(1, k)]
+
+    def ffs_cycles(self) -> typing.List[int]:
+        """Cycles of the postop bitmaps feeding the generator's FFS insts."""
+        num_ffs_insts = 2 + int(self.sram_counters)
+        return [self.start_cycle + int(self.sram_bitmap) + j - 1
+                for j in range(1, num_ffs_insts)]
 
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    # Definitions and the level's own always blocks
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
+    def state_defs(self) -> typing.List[typing.Tuple[str, str]]:
+        """Per-entry state and decide-stage signals of the PPU form."""
+        k = self.k
+        n = "NUM_COUNTERS_L{}".format(k)
+        defs = []
+        for v in ("b", "o", "b_n", "o_n", "mins", "maxs", "ehit"):
+            defs.append(("logic [{}-1:0]".format(n), "lx{}_{};".format(k, v)))
+        for v in ("c", "c_n"):
+            defs.append(("logic [{}-1:0][HEAP_ENTRY_AWIDTH-1:0]".format(n),
+                         "lx{}_{};".format(k, v)))
+        return defs
 
     def emit_stage_defs(self, cg: CodeGen) -> None:
         """Emit this level through the supplied CodeGen instance."""
-        raise NotImplementedError("Bitmap-level implementation removed")
+        k = self.k
+        n = "NUM_COUNTERS_L{}".format(k)
+        cg.comment("L{} state and pipeline metadata".format(k))
+        if k == 1:
+            # Loop trip counts above the simulator's unroll limit keep the
+            # generated simulation model compact for any bitmap width.
+            cg.emit("localparam LX_WLOOP = (HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH <= 16 || HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH > 64) ? HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH : 65;")
+            # Trees beyond the register-based state budget are unsupported:
+            # their heavy levels reduce to a stub so that build, simulation
+            # and synthesis stay short (such a configuration is not served).
+            cg.emit("localparam LX_HUGE = (HEAP_NUM_PRIORITIES > {});".format(
+                8192 if self.num_bitmap_levels in (2, 3) else 1024))
+        cg.emit([
+            "localparam LX_LOOP_L{0} = (NUM_COUNTERS_L{0} > 64) ? NUM_COUNTERS_L{0} : 65;".format(k),
+            "localparam LX_RLOOP_L{0} = (NUM_BITMAPS_L{0} > 64) ? NUM_BITMAPS_L{0} : 65;".format(k),
+            "localparam LX_NG_L{0} = (NUM_BITMAPS_L{0} + 63) / 64;".format(k),
+        ])
+        defs = []
+        if not self.last:
+            defs += self.state_defs()
+            defs.append(("bitmap_t", "lx{}_dnext;".format(k)))
+            if k > 1:
+                defs.append(("logic [{}-1:0]".format(n), "reg_lx{}_hit_s{};".format(k, self.d_stage)))
+            for c in range(self.digit_stage, self.digit_last_stage() + 1):
+                defs.append(("bitmap_t", self.digit_reg(k, c) + ";"))
+        for c in self.ffs_cycles():
+            defs.append(("bitmap_t", "reg_{}_bitmap_postop_s{};".format(self.name(), c)))
+        if self.last:
+            e, p = self.e_stage, self.p_stage
+            defs += [
+                ("heap_priority_t", "lx_prio_s{};".format(e)),
+                ("logic", "lx_old_b_s{};".format(e)),
+                ("logic", "lx_old_o_s{};".format(e)),
+                ("logic", "reg_lx_old_b_s{};".format(e)),
+                ("logic", "reg_lx_old_o_s{};".format(e)),
+                ("heap_priority_t", "priority_s{};".format(p)),
+            ]
+            for o in range(1, 5):
+                defs.append(("logic", "pb_addr_conflict_s{}_s{};".format(p + o, p)))
+            for o in range(1, 4):
+                defs.append(("logic", "reg_pb_addr_conflict_s{}_s{};".format(p + o, p)))
+            defs += [
+                ("counter_t", "reg_{}_counter_s{};".format(self.name(), p)),
+                ("counter_t", "reg_old_{}_counter_s{};".format(self.name(), p)),
+                ("logic", "reg_{}_counter_non_zero_s{};".format(self.name(), p)),
+            ]
+        cg.align_defs(defs, 60)
+        cg.emit()
+
+        if not self.last:
+            if k > 1:
+                cg.emit("if (!LX_HUGE) begin : g_lx{}_core".format(k))
+                cg.inc_level()
+            self.emit_decide_logic(cg)
+            if k > 1:
+                self.emit_reduce_logic(cg)
+                cg.dec_level()
+                cg.emit("end")
+                cg.emit()
+            return
+
+        # Leaf: register-per-entry (PPU) form for small trees, register-file
+        # (row read, forward, write back) form for large ones. Both have the
+        # same stage structure and produce the same encode-stage outputs.
+        rrf = self.rrf_supported()
+        cg.emit("localparam LX_LEAF_RRF = {};".format(
+            "(NUM_COUNTERS_L{} > 1024)".format(k) if rrf else "0"))
+        e = self.e_stage
+        cg.emit("if (LX_HUGE) begin : g_lx_stub")
+        cg.emit([
+            "    always_comb begin : lx_stub",
+            "        lx_prio_s{} = '0;".format(e),
+            "        lx_old_b_s{} = 1'b0;".format(e),
+            "        lx_old_o_s{} = 1'b0;".format(e),
+            "    end",
+            "end",
+        ])
+        cg.emit("else if (!LX_LEAF_RRF) begin : g_lx_ppu")
+        cg.inc_level()
+        part = "logic [LX_NG_L{}-1:0][HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0]".format(k)
+        d, r = self.d_stage, self.r_stage
+        ldefs = self.state_defs() + [
+            ("logic [{}-1:0]".format(n), "reg_lx{}_hit_s{};".format(k, d)),
+            ("logic [{}-1:0]".format(n), "reg_lx_hit_o_s{};".format(d)),
+            ("logic [{}-1:0]".format(n), "reg_lx_hit_b_s{};".format(d)),
+            (part, "lx_dpart;"),
+            (part, "lx_opart;"),
+            (part, "lx_bpart;"),
+            (part, "reg_lx_dpart_s{};".format(r)),
+            (part, "reg_lx_opart_s{};".format(r)),
+            (part, "reg_lx_bpart_s{};".format(r)),
+        ]
+        cg.align_defs(ldefs, 60)
+        cg.emit()
+        self.emit_decide_logic(cg)
+        self.emit_leaf_logic(cg)
+        cg.dec_level()
+        cg.emit("end")
+        if rrf:
+            cg.emit("else begin : g_lx_rrf")
+            cg.inc_level()
+            self.emit_rrf_leaf(cg)
+            cg.dec_level()
+            cg.emit("end")
+        cg.emit()
+        cg.emit("always_ff @(posedge clk) begin : lx_leaf_carry")
+        cg.inc_level()
+        self.emit_carries(cg)
+        cg.dec_level()
+        cg.emit("end")
+        cg.emit()
+        self.emit_pb_logic(cg)
+
+
+    def rrf_supported(self) -> bool:
+        return self.num_bitmap_levels in (2, 3)
+
+
+    def emit_decide_logic(self, cg: CodeGen) -> None:
+        """Decide stage: parallel update of every row of this level."""
+        k, c = self.k, self.d_stage
+        s = c - 1  # Input register index
+        n = "NUM_COUNTERS_L{}".format(k)
+        loop = "LX_LOOP_L{}".format(k)
+        cg.comment("L{} decide stage (S{})".format(k, c), True)
+        cg.emit("always_comb begin : lx{}_decide".format(k))
+        cg.inc_level()
+        cg.emit([
+            "logic sel;",
+            "logic acc;",
+            "logic [HEAP_LOG_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0] pd;",
+            "bitmap_t dec;",
+            "pd = {};".format(self.prio_digit(k, "reg_priority_s[{}]".format(s))),
+            "for (int i = 0; i < LX_WLOOP; i = i + 1) if (i < HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH) dec[i] = (pd == i);",
+        ])
+        sel = " & ".join(["reg_valid_s[{}]".format(s)] +
+                         self.row_select(s, "e >> HEAP_LOG_BITMAP_WIDTH"))
+        cg.emit([
+            "acc = 1'b0;",
+            "for (int e = 0; e < {}; e = e + 1) if (e < {}) begin".format(loop, n),
+            "    sel = {};".format(sel),
+            "    if ((e & BITMAP_IDX_MASK) == 0) acc = 1'b0;",
+            "    lx{0}_mins[e] = sel & reg_is_deque_min_s[{1}] & lx{0}_b[e] & ~acc;".format(k, s),
+            "    lx{0}_ehit[e] = sel & reg_is_enque_s[{1}] & dec[e & BITMAP_IDX_MASK];".format(k, s),
+            "    acc = acc | lx{0}_b[e];".format(k),
+            "end",
+            "acc = 1'b0;",
+            "for (int e = {} - 1; e >= 0; e = e - 1) if (e < {}) begin".format(loop, n),
+            "    sel = {};".format(sel),
+            "    if ((e & BITMAP_IDX_MASK) == BITMAP_IDX_MASK) acc = 1'b0;",
+            "    lx{0}_maxs[e] = sel & reg_is_deque_max_s[{1}] & lx{0}_b[e] & ~acc;".format(k, s),
+            "    acc = acc | lx{0}_b[e];".format(k),
+            "end",
+            "for (int e = 0; e < {}; e = e + 1) if (e < {}) begin".format(loop, n),
+            "    lx{0}_b_n[e] = lx{0}_b[e];".format(k),
+            "    lx{0}_o_n[e] = lx{0}_o[e];".format(k),
+            "    lx{0}_c_n[e] = lx{0}_c[e];".format(k),
+            "    if (lx{0}_ehit[e]) begin".format(k),
+            "        lx{0}_b_n[e] = 1'b1;".format(k),
+            "        lx{0}_o_n[e] = ~lx{0}_b[e];".format(k),
+            "        lx{0}_c_n[e] = lx{0}_c[e] + 1'b1;".format(k),
+            "    end",
+            "    else if (lx{0}_mins[e] | lx{0}_maxs[e]) begin".format(k),
+            "        lx{0}_b_n[e] = ~lx{0}_o[e];".format(k),
+            "        lx{0}_o_n[e] = (lx{0}_c[e] == 2);".format(k),
+            "        lx{0}_c_n[e] = lx{0}_c[e] - 1'b1;".format(k),
+            "    end",
+            "end",
+        ])
+        if k == 1 and not self.last:
+            cg.emit("lx1_dnext = (reg_is_enque_s[{0}] ? dec : '0) | lx1_mins | lx1_maxs;".format(s))
+        cg.dec_level()
+        cg.emit("end")
+        cg.emit()
+
+        # State update and pipeline registers
+        cg.emit("always_ff @(posedge clk) begin : lx{}_state".format(k))
+        cg.inc_level()
+        cg.emit([
+            "if (rst) begin",
+            "    lx{0}_b <= '0;".format(k),
+            "    lx{0}_o <= '0;".format(k),
+            "    lx{0}_c <= '0;".format(k),
+            "end",
+            "else begin",
+            "    lx{0}_b <= lx{0}_b_n;".format(k),
+            "    lx{0}_o <= lx{0}_o_n;".format(k),
+            "    lx{0}_c <= lx{0}_c_n;".format(k),
+            "end",
+        ])
+        # Pipeline registers (no reset needed: qualified by reg_valid_s)
+        if k == 1 and not self.last:
+            cg.emit("{} <= lx1_dnext;".format(self.digit_reg(1, c)))
+        if k > 1 or self.last:
+            cg.emit("reg_lx{0}_hit_s{1} <= lx{0}_mins | lx{0}_maxs | lx{0}_ehit;".format(k, c))
+        if self.last:
+            cg.emit("reg_lx_hit_o_s{1} <= (lx{0}_mins | lx{0}_maxs | lx{0}_ehit) & lx{0}_o;".format(k, c))
+            cg.emit("reg_lx_hit_b_s{1} <= (lx{0}_mins | lx{0}_maxs | lx{0}_ehit) & lx{0}_b;".format(k, c))
+        if not self.last:
+            self.emit_carries(cg)
+        cg.dec_level()
+        cg.emit("end")
+        cg.emit()
+
+
+    def emit_carries(self, cg: CodeGen) -> None:
+        """Carry earlier digits through this level's stages."""
+        for j in range(1, self.k + 1):
+            lvl = self.bbq.bitmap_levels[j - 1]
+            if lvl.last:
+                continue
+            for cc in range(max(lvl.digit_stage + 1, self.start_cycle),
+                            min(self.end_cycle, self.digit_last_stage()) + 1):
+                cg.emit("{} <= {};".format(self.digit_reg(j, cc), self.digit_reg(j, cc - 1)))
+        for cc in self.ffs_cycles():
+            cg.emit("reg_{}_bitmap_postop_s{} <= '0;".format(self.name(), cc))
+
+
+    def emit_rrf_leaf(self, cg: CodeGen) -> None:
+        """Register-file leaf for large trees.
+
+        Rows (bitmap, count-is-one flags, counters) live in register files
+        read through one-hot row selects. S0 reads the operation's row (for
+        three levels the row group is pre-read in S0-1, and S0 patches it
+        with the post-operation row of the operation two ahead); S1 forwards
+        the post-operation row of the operation one ahead, decides and writes
+        the row back; S2 encodes the priority and the bucket flags.
+        """
+        D, k = self.num_bitmap_levels, self.k
+        s0, s1, e = self.start_cycle, self.start_cycle + 1, self.e_stage
+        cnt = "logic [HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0][HEAP_ENTRY_AWIDTH-1:0]"
+        aw = "BITMAP_L{}_AWIDTH".format(k)
+        nr = "NUM_BITMAPS_L{}".format(k)
+        rl = "LX_RLOOP_L{}".format(k)
+        defs = [
+            ("bitmap_t", "f_b[{}-1:0];".format(nr)),
+            ("bitmap_t", "f_o[{}-1:0];".format(nr)),
+            (cnt, "f_c[{}-1:0];".format(nr)),
+            ("logic", "f_init;"),
+            ("logic [{}-1:0]".format(aw), "f_ictr;"),
+            ("bitmap_t", "r_b;"), ("bitmap_t", "r_o;"), (cnt, "r_c;"),
+            ("bitmap_t", "reg_r_b;"), ("bitmap_t", "reg_r_o;"), (cnt, "reg_r_c;"),
+            ("logic", "fwd;"), ("logic", "reg_fwd;"),
+            ("logic [{}-1:0]".format(aw), "rowbin;"),
+            ("logic [{}-1:0]".format(aw), "reg_rowbin;"),
+            ("bitmap_t", "b_in;"), ("bitmap_t", "o_in;"), (cnt, "c_in;"),
+            ("bitmap_t", "mins;"), ("bitmap_t", "maxs;"), ("bitmap_t", "ehit;"),
+            ("bitmap_t", "p_b;"), ("bitmap_t", "p_o;"), (cnt, "p_c;"),
+            ("bitmap_t", "reg_p_b;"), ("bitmap_t", "reg_p_o;"), (cnt, "reg_p_c;"),
+            ("bitmap_t", "reg_pick;"), ("bitmap_t", "reg_old_b;"), ("bitmap_t", "reg_old_o;"),
+        ]
+        if D == 3:
+            defs += [
+                ("bitmap_t", "g_b[HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0];"),
+                ("bitmap_t", "g_o[HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0];"),
+                (cnt, "g_c[HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0];"),
+                ("bitmap_t", "reg_g_b[HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0];"),
+                ("bitmap_t", "reg_g_o[HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0];"),
+                (cnt, "reg_g_c[HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0];"),
+                ("logic", "reg_m1;"), ("logic", "reg_m2;"),
+            ]
+        cg.align_defs(defs, 60)
+        cg.emit()
+
+        def enc(src: str, dst: str) -> typing.List[str]:
+            return ["{} = '0;".format(dst),
+                    "for (int i = 0; i < LX_WLOOP; i = i + 1) if (i < HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH) "
+                    "if ({}[i]) {} = {} | i[HEAP_LOG_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0];".format(src, dst, dst)]
+
+        d1 = lambda c: self.digit_reg(1, c)
+        if D == 3:
+            d2 = lambda c: self.digit_reg(2, c)
+            g = s0 - 1
+            cg.comment("Leaf group pre-read (S{})".format(g), True)
+            cg.emit("always_comb begin : lx_rrf_group")
+            cg.inc_level()
+            cg.emit([
+                "for (int j = 0; j < LX_WLOOP; j = j + 1) if (j < HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH) begin",
+                "    g_b[j] = '0;",
+                "    g_o[j] = '0;",
+                "    g_c[j] = '0;",
+                "end",
+                "for (int r = 0; r < {}; r = r + 1) if (r < {}) begin".format(rl, nr),
+                "    if ({}[r >> HEAP_LOG_BITMAP_WIDTH]) begin".format(d1(g - 1)),
+                "        g_b[r & BITMAP_IDX_MASK] = g_b[r & BITMAP_IDX_MASK] | f_b[r];",
+                "        g_o[r & BITMAP_IDX_MASK] = g_o[r & BITMAP_IDX_MASK] | f_o[r];",
+                "        g_c[r & BITMAP_IDX_MASK] = g_c[r & BITMAP_IDX_MASK] | f_c[r];",
+                "    end",
+                "end",
+            ])
+            cg.dec_level()
+            cg.emit("end")
+            cg.emit()
+            cg.emit("always_ff @(posedge clk) begin : lx_rrf_group_regs")
+            cg.inc_level()
+            cg.emit([
+                "reg_g_b <= g_b;",
+                "reg_g_o <= g_o;",
+                "reg_g_c <= g_c;",
+                "reg_m1 <= reg_valid_s[{0}] & reg_valid_s[{1}] & (|({2} & {3}));".format(g - 1, g, d1(g - 1), d1(g)),
+                "reg_m2 <= reg_valid_s[{0}] & reg_valid_s[{1}] & (|({2} & {3}));".format(g - 1, g + 1, d1(g - 1), d1(g + 1)),
+            ])
+            cg.dec_level()
+            cg.emit("end")
+            cg.emit()
+
+        cg.comment("Leaf row read (S{})".format(s0), True)
+        cg.emit("always_comb begin : lx_rrf_read")
+        cg.inc_level()
+        if D == 3:
+            cg.emit([
+                "logic [HEAP_LOG_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0] hi;",
+                "logic [HEAP_LOG_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0] lo;",
+                "logic m2;",
+                "r_b = '0;",
+                "r_o = '0;",
+                "r_c = '0;",
+                "for (int j = 0; j < LX_WLOOP; j = j + 1) if (j < HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH) begin",
+                "    if ({}[j]) begin".format(d2(s0 - 1)),

+
+At selection the low three count bits are current. The magnitude bit was
+sampled at most three accepted operations behind them. At residue two, an
+actual count of two was at most five at sampling, whereas ten or more was
+at least seven. A delayed count >= 6 thus distinguishes the two cases.

+

+"""Reversible RAM counter with a fast occupancy-threshold output."""
+
+from codegen import CodeGen
+
+
+# Low coefficients of primitive binary polynomials, with the leading term
+# implicit. The affine shift starts at zero and visits 2**width - 1 states.
+_TAPS = {5: 5, 6: 3, 7: 3, 8: 29, 9: 17, 10: 9, 11: 5, 12: 83,
+         13: 27, 14: 1091, 15: 3, 16: 45, 17: 9}
+
+
+def emit_update(cg: CodeGen, n: str, cycle: int, threshold: int) -> None:
+    """Update the encoded position and the flag for count >= threshold.
+
+    Only the empty and full counts share an LFSR position. Their flags
+    differ. In either direction the flag can change at just one position.
+    """
+    taps = "\n    ".join(f"HEAP_ENTRY_AWIDTH == {w} ? HEAP_ENTRY_AWIDTH'({p}) :" for w, p in _TAPS.items())
+    cg.emit(f"""
+localparam [HEAP_ENTRY_AWIDTH-1:0] {n}_poly =
+    {taps} '0;
+wire {n}_new_large;
+if ({n}_poly != 0) begin : {n}_shift_counter
+    function automatic [HEAP_ENTRY_AWIDTH-1:0] advance(input logic [HEAP_ENTRY_AWIDTH-1:0] value);
+        advance = (value << 1) ^ (value[HEAP_ENTRY_AWIDTH-1] ? {n}_poly : '0) ^ HEAP_ENTRY_AWIDTH'(1);
+    endfunction
+    function automatic [HEAP_ENTRY_AWIDTH-1:0] position(input integer number);
+        position = '0;
+        for (int i=0; i<number; i=i+1) position = advance(position);
+    endfunction
+    wire [HEAP_ENTRY_AWIDTH-1:0] x = {n}_base[HEAP_ENTRY_AWIDTH-1:0];
+    wire [HEAP_ENTRY_AWIDTH-1:0] retreat =
+        {{!x[0], x[HEAP_ENTRY_AWIDTH-1:1]}} ^ (!x[0] ? ({n}_poly >> 1) : '0);
+    assign {n}_new_large = reg_is_enque_s[{cycle}]
+        ? ({n}_base[WATERLEVEL_IDX] || x == position({threshold-1}))
+        : ({n}_base[WATERLEVEL_IDX] && x != position({threshold}));
+    assign {n}_new_count = {{{n}_new_large, (reg_is_enque_s[{cycle}] ? advance(x) : retreat)}};
+end else begin : {n}_binary_counter
+    wire [HEAP_ENTRY_AWIDTH-1:0] value = {n}_base[HEAP_ENTRY_AWIDTH-1:0];
+    assign {n}_new_large = reg_is_enque_s[{cycle}] ? (value >= {threshold-1}) : (value > {threshold});
+    assign {n}_new_count = {{{n}_new_large, (reg_is_enque_s[{cycle}] ?
+        HEAP_ENTRY_AWIDTH'(value + 1'b1) : HEAP_ENTRY_AWIDTH'(value - 1'b1))}};
+end""".strip().splitlines())

+

+is occupied. Dequeue-max uses the symmetric test. The two range counts

+    function automatic bitmap_t fill(input bitmap_t bits, input logic toward_high);
+        fill = bits;
+        for (int p=0; p<HEAP_LOG_BITMAP_WIDTH; p=p+1)
+            fill = fill | (toward_high ? (fill << (1 << p)) : (fill >> (1 << p)));
+    endfunction

+    wire [HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0] last_bit = live & ~(fill(live, 1'b0) >> 1);
+    wire [HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0] selected = reg_is_deque_min_s[{t}] ? first_bit : last_bit;
+    for (genvar p=0; p<HEAP_LOG_BITMAP_WIDTH; p=p+1) begin : encode
+        localparam bitmap_t MASK = (~bitmap_t'(0) / ((bitmap_t'(1) << (1 << p)) + 1'b1)) << (1 << p);
+        assign {n}_digit[p] = reg_is_enque_s[{t}] ? reg_priority_s[{t}][{n}_shift+p] : (|(selected & MASK));

+            end else begin

+                if (old_count == 1) live <= live & ~selected;
+            end

+    end

+    bitmap_t {n}_lower, {n}_upper, {n}_push_lower;
+    always_ff @(posedge clk)
+        {n}_push_lower <= (~bitmap_t'(0)) << in_he_priority[{n}_shift +: HEAP_LOG_BITMAP_WIDTH];

+        reg_is_deque_min_s[{t}] ? {n}_lower : ~{n}_upper;

+        bitmap_t live;
+        wire [HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0] add = reg_is_enque_s[{t}]
+            ? ((side == 0) ? {n}_push_lower : ~{n}_push_lower) : '0;
+        wire [HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0] sub = reg_is_enque_s[{t}]
+            ? '0 : ((side == 0) ? {n}_pop_lower : ~{n}_pop_lower);
+        bitmap_t digit[HEAP_ENTRY_AWIDTH-1:0];
+        always_ff @(posedge clk) begin : update_range
+            bitmap_t all_ones, all_zeros, upper_bits;
+            all_ones = '1;
+            all_zeros = '1;
+            upper_bits = '0;
+            for (int b=0; b<HEAP_ENTRY_AWIDTH; b=b+1) begin
+                if (rst) digit[b] <= '0;
+                else if (lx_accepted) digit[b] <= digit[b] ^ ((add & all_ones) | (sub & all_zeros));
+                all_ones = all_ones & digit[b];
+                all_zeros = all_zeros & ~digit[b];
+                if (b != 0) upper_bits = upper_bits | digit[b];
+            end
+            if (rst) live <= '0;
+            else if (lx_accepted) live <= add | (live & ~(sub & ~upper_bits));
+        end
+        if (side == 0) assign {n}_lower = live;
+        else assign {n}_upper = live;
+    end
+    wire [HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0] {n}_min_mask = {n}_lower & ~({n}_lower << 1);
+    wire [HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0] {n}_max_mask = ~{n}_upper & ~((~{n}_upper) << 1);
+    for (genvar p=0; p<HEAP_LOG_BITMAP_WIDTH; p=p+1) begin : {n}_encode
+        localparam bitmap_t MASK = (~bitmap_t'(0) / ((bitmap_t'(1) << (1 << p)) + 1'b1)) << (1 << p);
+        assign {n}_digit[p] = ((|({n}_min_mask & MASK)) && reg_is_deque_min_s[{t}]) ||

+    wire last_child = !(|({n}_occupied >> (b+1)));
+    assign {n}_selected[b] = (reg_is_enque_s[{t}] && reg_priority_s[{t}] == b)
+        || ({n}_occupied[b] && ((first_child && reg_is_deque_min_s[{t}]) || (last_child && reg_is_deque_max_s[{t}])));
+    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
+        if (rst) count <= '0;
+        else if ({level.input_valid()} && {n}_selected[b])
+            count <= reg_is_enque_s[{t}] ? count + 1'b1 : count - 1'b1;
+    end
+end

+    assign {n}_priority[p] = |({n}_selected & MASK);

+    {n}_old_single <= |({n}_selected & {n}_singletons);
+    {n}_old_empty <= !(|({n}_selected & {n}_occupied));
+end""".strip().splitlines())

+"""RAM bitmap traversal for large trees.
+
+Read the counter for the winner under the assumption the last dequeue
+exhausted its child. If the other outcome changes the winner, the new
+winner is that preceding child, whose counter is available by forwarding.
+Retain both bitmap results through the counter read and resolve the
+priority digit before passing the request to the following level. Two low
+count bits and a count >= 4 flag classify an updated count without putting
+a full increment or decrement on the forwarding path. For very wide rows,
+resolve the previous choice before encoding the next digit to share the
+priority encoder across both outcomes.
+"""
+
+
+def emit_datapath(level, cg):
+    n = level.name()
+    s, k = level.start_cycle, level.select_cycle
+    W = 'HEAP_LOG_BITMAP_WIDTH'
+    shift = f'{n}_shift'
+    rw = f'BITMAP_L{level.id}_AWIDTH'
+
+    def priority(c):
+        if c == k:
+            return f"{n}_resolved"
+        if c == s - 1 and level.prev_level.name() != "steering":
+            return f"{level.prev_level.name()}_current"
+        return f"reg_priority_s[{c}]"
+
+    def row(c):
+        return f'{priority(c)}[HEAP_PRIORITY_BUCKETS_AWIDTH-1:{shift}+{W}]'
+
+    def emit(src):
+        cg.emit(src.strip().splitlines())
+
+    emit(f"""
+localparam {shift} = (HEAP_NUM_LEVELS - {level.id}) * {W};
+heap_priority_t {n}_resolved;
+counter_t {n}_written, {n}_ram_sample, {n}_new_count;
+logic {n}_same_parent1, {n}_same_parent2, {n}_recent_count;
+always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
+    {n}_same_parent1 <= reg_valid_s[{k}] && ({row(k-1)} == {row(k)});
+    {n}_same_parent2 <= reg_valid_s[{k+1}] && ({row(k-1)} == {row(k+1)});
+end
+wire {n}_repeat1 = {n}_same_parent1 && ({n}_resolved[{shift} +: {W}] == reg_priority_s[{k+1}][{shift} +: {W}]);
+wire {n}_repeat2 = {n}_same_parent2 && ({n}_resolved[{shift} +: {W}] == reg_priority_s[{k+2}][{shift} +: {W}]);
+always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
+    {n}_recent_count <= {n}_repeat1;
+    {n}_ram_sample <= {n}_repeat2 ? {n}_written : counter_{n}_q;
+end
+wire [COUNTER_T_WIDTH-1:0] {n}_base = {n}_recent_count ? {n}_written : {n}_ram_sample;
+wire [COUNTER_T_WIDTH-1:0] {n}_sample = {n}_repeat2 ? {n}_written : counter_{n}_q;
+wire {n}_after_many = {n}_base[WATERLEVEL_IDX] ||
+    (reg_is_enque_s[{k+1}] ? (|{n}_base[1:0]) : (&{n}_base[1:0]));
+wire {n}_after_one = !{n}_base[WATERLEVEL_IDX] && ({n}_base[1:0] == (reg_is_enque_s[{k+1}] ? 0 : 2));
+wire {n}_after_zero = !{n}_base[WATERLEVEL_IDX] && ({n}_base[1:0] == 1) && !reg_is_enque_s[{k+1}];
+wire {n}_keep = reg_is_enque_s[{k}] || ({n}_repeat1 ? {n}_after_many : ({n}_sample[WATERLEVEL_IDX] || {n}_sample[1]));
+wire {n}_was_single = {n}_repeat1 ? {n}_after_one : (!{n}_sample[WATERLEVEL_IDX] && {n}_sample[1:0] == 1);
+wire {n}_was_empty = {n}_repeat1 ? {n}_after_zero : (!{n}_sample[WATERLEVEL_IDX] && {n}_sample[1:0] == 0);
+wire [HEAP_ENTRY_AWIDTH-1:0] {n}_value = {n}_base[HEAP_ENTRY_AWIDTH-1:0];
+wire [HEAP_ENTRY_AWIDTH-1:0] {n}_result = reg_is_enque_s[{k+1}] ? {n}_value + 1'b1 : {n}_value - 1'b1;
+assign {n}_new_count = {{(reg_is_enque_s[{k+1}] ? ({n}_value >= 3) : ({n}_value > 4)),{n}_result}};
+always_ff @(posedge clk) {n}_written <= {n}_new_count;
+
+localparam {n}_span = HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH > 64 ? HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH : (HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH >= 4 ? 4 : HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH);
+localparam {n}_groups = HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH / {n}_span;
+typedef logic [{n}_groups+HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0] {n}_word_t;
+{n}_word_t {n}_yes_regs[1:0], {n}_no_regs[1:0], {n}_last_yes_regs[1:0], {n}_last_no_regs[1:0];
+logic {n}_source_q;
+always_ff @(posedge clk) {n}_source_q <= {n}_keep;
+wire [{n}_groups+HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0] {n}_yes = {n}_yes_regs[{n}_source_q];
+wire [{n}_groups+HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0] {n}_no = {n}_no_regs[{n}_source_q];
+wire [{n}_groups+HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0] {n}_last_yes = {n}_last_yes_regs[{n}_source_q];
+wire [{n}_groups+HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0] {n}_last_no = {n}_last_no_regs[{n}_source_q];
+{n}_word_t {n}_write_yes, {n}_write_no;
+always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
+    {n}_write_yes <= {n}_last_yes;
+    {n}_write_no <= {n}_last_no;
+end
+wire [{n}_groups+HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0] {n}_stored = {n}_source_q ? {n}_write_yes : {n}_write_no;
+wire [{rw}-1:0] {n}_fetch_addr = {row(s-1)};
+wire {n}_hit_last = reg_valid_s[{k-1}] && ({n}_fetch_addr == {row(k-1)});
+wire {n}_hit_write = reg_valid_s[{k}] && ({n}_fetch_addr == {row(k)});
+""")
+    if level.sram_bitmap:
+        emit(f"""
+{n}_word_t {n}_prev;
+always_ff @(posedge clk) {n}_prev <= {n}_stored;
+wire {n}_hit_prev = reg_valid_s[{k+2}] && ({n}_fetch_addr == {row(k+2)});
+wire [HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0] {n}_raw = bm_{n}_q;
+""")
+        src = f'({n}_hit_prev ? {n}_prev : {n}_raw_word)'
+    else:
+        emit(f"wire [HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0] {n}_raw = {n}_bitmaps[{n}_fetch_addr];")
+        src = f'{n}_raw_word'
+    emit(f"""
+{n}_word_t {n}_raw_word;
+assign {n}_raw_word[HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0] = {n}_raw;
+for (genvar g=0; g<{n}_groups; g=g+1)
+    assign {n}_raw_word[HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH+g] = HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH > 64 ? 1'b0 : (|{n}_raw[g*{n}_span +: {n}_span]);
+wire [{n}_groups+HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0] {n}_background = (reg_valid_s[{k+1}] && ({n}_fetch_addr == {row(k+1)})) ? {n}_stored : {src};
+bitmap_t {n}_enq_bits;
+always_ff @(posedge clk)
+    {n}_enq_bits <= reg_is_enque_s[{s-1}] ? bitmap_t'(1) << reg_priority_s[{s-1}][{shift} +: {W}] : '0;
+{n}_word_t {n}_keep_options[1:0], {n}_clear_options[1:0];
+logic [{W}-1:0] {n}_index[1:0];
+localparam {n}_parallel_paths = HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH > 128 ? 1 : 2;
+for (genvar v=0; v<{n}_parallel_paths; v=v+1) begin : {n}_path
+    bitmap_t live, drop;
+    logic [{n}_groups-1:0] group_live, keep_groups, drop_groups;
+    assign {{group_live, live}} = ({n}_parallel_paths == 1) ? ({n}_keep ? {n}_yes : {n}_no) : ((v == 0) ? {n}_no : {n}_yes);
+    bitmap_t pop_bits;
+    if (HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH > 64) begin : wide
+        function automatic bitmap_t fill(input bitmap_t bits, input logic toward_high);
+            fill = bits;
+            for (int p=0; p<{W}; p=p+1)
+                fill = fill | (toward_high ? (fill << (1 << p)) : (fill >> (1 << p)));
+        endfunction
+        wire [HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0] first_bit = live & ~(fill(live, 1'b1) << 1);
+        wire [HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0] last_bit = live & ~(fill(live, 1'b0) >> 1);
+        assign pop_bits = (reg_is_deque_min_s[{k-1}] ? first_bit : '0)
+                        | (reg_is_deque_max_s[{k-1}] ? last_bit : '0);
+        assign keep_groups = '0;
+        assign drop_groups = '0;
+    end else begin : grouped
+        localparam bitmap_t STARTS = ~bitmap_t'(0) / ((bitmap_t'(1) << {n}_span)-1'b1);
+        localparam bitmap_t ENDS = STARTS << ({n}_span-1);
+        wire [HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0] lo1 = live | ((live << 1) & ~STARTS);
+        wire [HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0] hi1 = live | ((live >> 1) & ~ENDS);
+        wire [HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0] lo2 = lo1 | ((lo1 << 2) & ~(STARTS | (STARTS << 1)));
+        wire [HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0] hi2 = hi1 | ((hi1 >> 2) & ~(ENDS | (ENDS >> 1)));
+        wire [HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0] first_bit = live & ~((lo2 << 1) & ~STARTS);
+        wire [HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0] last_bit = live & ~((hi2 >> 1) & ~ENDS);
+        wire [HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0] local_choice = reg_is_deque_min_s[{k-1}] ? first_bit : last_bit;
+        bitmap_t lane_enable;
+        for (genvar g=0; g<{n}_groups; g=g+1) begin : cluster
+            localparam OFFSET = g * {n}_span;
+            wire min_here = reg_is_deque_min_s[{k-1}] && !(|(group_live & ((1 << g)-1)));
+            wire max_here = reg_is_deque_max_s[{k-1}] && !(|(group_live >> (g+1)));
+            wire active_group = min_here || max_here;
+            wire inserting = |{n}_enq_bits[OFFSET +: {n}_span];
+            wire several = |(live[OFFSET +: {n}_span] & ~first_bit[OFFSET +: {n}_span]);
+            assign keep_groups[g] = group_live[g] || inserting;
+            assign drop_groups[g] = inserting || (group_live[g] && (several || !active_group));
+            assign lane_enable[OFFSET +: {n}_span] = {{{n}_span{{active_group}}}};
+        end
+        assign pop_bits = local_choice & lane_enable;
+    end
+    assign drop = live & ~pop_bits;
+    assign {n}_keep_options[v] = {{keep_groups,(live | {n}_enq_bits)}};
+    assign {n}_clear_options[v] = {{drop_groups,(drop | {n}_enq_bits)}};
+    for (genvar p=0; p<{W}; p=p+1) begin : encode
+        localparam bitmap_t MASK = (~bitmap_t'(0) / ((bitmap_t'(1) << (1 << p)) + 1'b1)) << (1 << p);
+        assign {n}_index[v][p] = |(pop_bits & MASK);
+    end
+end
+if ({n}_parallel_paths == 1) begin
+    assign {n}_keep_options[1] = {n}_keep_options[0];
+    assign {n}_clear_options[1] = {n}_clear_options[0];
+    assign {n}_index[1] = {n}_index[0];
+end
+for (genvar v=0; v<2; v=v+1) begin : {n}_prepare
+    wire [{n}_groups+HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0] bg = {n}_hit_write ?
+        ((v == 0) ? {n}_last_no : {n}_last_yes) : {n}_background;
+    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
+        {n}_yes_regs[v] <= {n}_hit_last ? {n}_keep_options[v] : bg;
+        {n}_no_regs[v] <= {n}_hit_last ? {n}_clear_options[v] : bg;
+        {n}_last_yes_regs[v] <= {n}_keep_options[v];
+        {n}_last_no_regs[v] <= {n}_clear_options[v];
+    end
+end
+wire [{W}-1:0] {n}_read_digit = reg_is_enque_s[{k-1}] ?
+    reg_priority_s[{k-1}][{shift} +: {W}] : {n}_index[0];
+wire [COUNTER_L{level.id}_AWIDTH-1:0] {n}_counter_read = {{{row(k-1)},{n}_read_digit}};
+logic [{W}-1:0] {n}_other_digit;
+logic {n}_use_other;
+always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
+    {n}_other_digit <= {n}_index[1];
+    {n}_use_other <= ({n}_parallel_paths == 2) && {n}_keep && !reg_is_enque_s[{k-1}];
+end
+always_comb begin
+    {n}_resolved = reg_priority_s[{k}];
+    if ({n}_use_other) {n}_resolved[{shift} +: {W}] = {n}_other_digit;
+end
+heap_priority_t {n}_priority;
+always_comb begin
+    {n}_priority = reg_priority_s[{k-1}];
+    if (!reg_is_enque_s[{k-1}]) {n}_priority[{shift} +: {W}] = {n}_index[0];
+end""")
